title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Thursday, 15 October 2026
description: AI's soaring electricity demand strains power grids as Anthropic expands its international workforce, Australia's Land Forces expo sets six defence technology priorities within a $425B decade-long spending plan, Queensland takes its community cabinet to Goondiwindi, and the Gold Coast seeks a developer for the Nerang precinct amid a Bilinga tower height dispute. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
